items.title: UK house prices grow at slowest pace in two years as mortgage rates rise
items.summary: Nationwide reports annual UK house price growth slowed to 0.5% in October as higher borrowing costs weighed on buyers.

items.title: Financial Conduct Authority issues warning over Northern Index Clone firm
items.summary: The FCA warns consumers against dealing with an unauthorised clone firm operating under the name Northern Index.

items.title: Precautionary closures amid protests carry no insurance guarantee
items.summary: Businesses closing doors ahead of unrest face strict policy limits as standard property damage and business interruption wordings require physical damage or formal authority orders.

items.title: Aon expands IBEX transaction insurance product to the UK and EEA
items.summary: Aon has expanded its proprietary IBEX transaction insurance product to cover the UK and EEA, offering 100 days of true interim breach coverage.

items.title: Tokio Marine HCC International and Adrian Flux launch UK insurance for domestic humanoid robots
items.summary: Tokio Marine HCC International and Adrian Flux have introduced a specialist household insurance policy designed for domestic humanoid robots arriving in UK homes.

items.title: Gallagher research points to rising UK workplace conflicts
items.summary: Insurance broker Gallagher reports an increase in UK workplace complaints resulting in attempted legal action.
